title: Looks nice, but doesn’t light…
text:
Looks nice, but doesn’t light…. [[VIDEOID:6590cb3efe26509143d3023967b0e7fc]] This garland looks good and I like the paradox snow tips. The lights would not work. I tried everything to get them to turn on. The battery case is one of the cheapest I’ve seen.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
